kind: Cyber Hex Grid environment visual upgrade

environment.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 via ANGLE Direct3D11
environment.models: Actual V3 Iron Vanguard on the local player and all seven AI combatants

method: Two independent final-asset live matches with seven actively fighting AI bots and a stationary first-person player, including normal deaths, respawns, weapon and impact effects. Two seconds warmup followed by 15 seconds of requestAnimationFrame interval sampling. All runtime source edits, authoring, builds and typechecks finished before sampling. Overview camera overrides were used only for separate screenshots, never for performance samples. Draw and triangle counters include rendered passes and shadows. Random combat makes these workload samples, not a controlled tier comparison.

assets.provenance: Original Blender columns, tactical cover, recharge crates, spherical reactor cage and remote relay fins. Original deterministic physical hex-floor textures. Shared approved Stadium generated ceramic albedo and authored coating maps. Actual shipped V3 character assets remain unchanged.

quitCleanup.note: The existing directional key light remains in the detached scene; Cyber geometry, material handles and the environment are released.

checks.gameplayData: Original circular 20 m base radius, 0.2 m floor thickness with surface at y=0, nine exact authored obstacle transforms and collider dimensions, eight original spawn points and existing game-mode behavior preserved. Existing roster floor scaling still reaches 27.5 m radius with player plus seven bots. Decorative subdeck and relay fins follow floor scaling, while cover and collision data stay fixed. No movement settings or sprint calibration changes.
checks.testCountsNote: Suites contain overlapping shared tests; counts are not unique tests.
checks.integrationReview: No actionable ownership, loading, cleanup, map-size or movement findings.

limits: Final samples exceed the 60 FPS target on average and at p95 on this high-end GPU at 1080p, but p99 intervals still exceed 16.67 ms. This is not a locked-60 certification or a guarantee for lower GPUs or higher resolutions. Existing warnings about undefined emissive parameters and deprecated THREE.Clock remain; no new shader failures or uncaught page errors appeared in successful-load runs. Expected network errors appeared during the deliberately blocked-download check. The production client build retains existing large-chunk warnings.
